create_GumbelVectorQuantizer: create a GumbelVectorQuantizer module with specified dim, num_vars, temp, groups, and vq_dim parameters
forward_GumbelVectorQuantizer: run forward pass on input tensor x through the GumbelVectorQuantizer to get quantized output
sample_from_codebook: sample random vectors from the GumbelVectorQuantizer codebook with batch size b and sample count n
codebook_GumbelVectorQuantizer: retrieve the full codebook tensor from the GumbelVectorQuantizer using the codebook method
set_num_updates_GumbelVectorQuantizer: set the number of training updates to decay the temperature in GumbelVectorQuantizer
